lessons: Fix the race in `group_exited` (tests/waiting.py:18): `/proc/<pid>/stat` can vanish between open and read, so `read_text()` raises ProcessLookupError. Treat that error as the process being gone, as the ticket's 'process group being gone' event requires.

Check every other `/proc` read in tests/waiting.py for the same race. A process can exit at any point during the check, so each read must treat its disappearance as exited rather than let the error escape the `wait_until` predicate.

Keep the fix in the helper. The failures, `test_event_callback_unwind_kills_group[abort-claude]` and `[cancel-codex]`, hit the same line. The ticket's Definition of rejected forbids skipping, retrying, marking serial, or lengthening a bound.

Three clean runs did not prove this fix: the attempt's own runs passed, then Check failed on a timing race. After the fix, rerun the Verification commands and confirm each of the three runs exits 0 in under 120 seconds, and treat any new failure as a root cause to fix.
